title: Education Support
description: We help students overcome financial barriers that can interrupt their education, such as school fees, exam fees, and books. Headteachers verify each recipient, and donors receive updates every term.
teaser: Covering school fees, exam fees, and books so a financial gap doesn't end a student's year.
bullets: Needs-based support verified by headteachers and ward committees
Covers tuition, hostel, lab fees, books, and exam costs
Progress updates shared with donors each term
impact: Impact: 100+ students supported since 2023 with 95% year-over-year retention.

image.alt: Students working at their desks in a classroom

title: Mentorship & Exposure
description: Weekly calls and career conversations with Nepali mentors who understand the journey. Mentors help students see paths and possibilities beyond their immediate surroundings, and check in on attendance, grades, and goals.
teaser: Weekly calls and career conversations that connect students to guidance and possibilities beyond their village.
bullets: Weekly check-ins on attendance, grades, and personal goals
Career conversations with Nepali professionals, including in tech
Peer study groups and accountability circles
impact: Impact: 40+ mentors volunteering weekly to coach students across Dhading.

image.alt: Students, parents, and teachers seated together in a classroom for a school community meeting

title: Digital Opportunity
description: Many students in rural communities encounter computers much later than their peers elsewhere. We work with partner schools to give students guided, hands-on time with technology, so they start building digital skills before they leave school.
teaser: Guided, hands-on time with technology at partner schools.
bullets: Guided digital learning sessions at partner schools
Basic digital skills alongside regular coursework
Conversations about technology careers with volunteer mentors
impact: Impact: Structured digital access supported at 10+ partner classrooms since 2023.
